title: Hold Menu
description: A shelf of Beatles records with an iOS-style long press. Hold a cover and it gives a little, then lifts free and crisp on a spring while the shelf softens and dims behind it; a full-size menu opens beside it with Play Next, Add to Queue, Share Album and Go to Album. Keep holding, slide onto an action and let go to choose it, or right-click, or use the keyboard.
intent: The context-menu moment from a music app finished to the edge: press, lift, dim, open, slide and release, with a spring that retargets the moment you let go and a lifted cover that is always sharp.
